'''Gar Bettle''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Bettle owned [[Hedrett Holovid]], a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] rental shop. One of his most regular customers was [[Nek Lawsirk]], a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], who was a fan of [[Jedi Action genre|Jedi Action]] holovids. Bettle disliked Jedi Action vids and tried to persuade Lawsirk to watch something different, but the Zabrak refused to listen. When Lawsirk went missing, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] spoke to Bettle during the course of their investigations to find the absent knight.
